index.summary: Add --occurred-at to porcelain commands and improve monotonicity diagnostics

task.title: Add --occurred-at to porcelain commands and improve monotonicity diagnostics
task.objective: Add --occurred-at option to task start, verify, finish, block, resume, and review approve commands; improve error diagnostic to report minimal acceptable timestamp when monotonicity is violated; allow occurred_at == updated_at for record appends.
task.rationale: Prevents porcelain commands from permanently failing on tasks whose timestamps ran ahead of wall clock (Issue 1).

acceptance.criterion: Porcelain commands accept --occurred-at and monotonicity errors explicitly report the minimal acceptable timestamp.
